environment.title: Environment
environment.description: The environment Either SANDBOX or PRODUCTION

inBody.title: In Body
inBody.description: Sets the name of a parameter to be passed in the exchange In Body

merchantId.title: Merchant Id
merchantId.description: The merchant id provided by Braintree.

lazyStartProducer.title: Lazy Start Producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

httpReadTimeout.title: Http Read Timeout
httpReadTimeout.description: Set read timeout for http calls.

httpLogLevel.title: Http Log Level
httpLogLevel.description: Set logging level for http calls, see java.util.logging.Level

httpLogName.title: Http Log Name
httpLogName.description: Set log category to use to log http calls.

logHandlerEnabled.title: Log Handler Enabled
logHandlerEnabled.description: Sets whether to enable the BraintreeLogHandler. It may be desirable to set this to 'false' where an existing JUL - SLF4J logger bridge is on the classpath. This option can also be configured globally on the BraintreeComponent.

accessToken.title: Access Token
accessToken.description: The access token granted by a merchant to another in order to process transactions on their behalf. Used in place of environment, merchant id, public key and private key fields.

privateKey.title: Private Key
privateKey.description: The private key provided by Braintree.

publicKey.title: Public Key
publicKey.description: The public key provided by Braintree.
